title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Service Standards by Tier
content:
Two service figures are recorded against a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier. The first is whether the tier reaches a dedicated service line rather than the general queue. The second is the number of hours within which a written service request is answered.

| Tier | Service line | Written request answered within, hours |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | general queue | 72 |
| Wanderlane Silver | general queue | 48 |
| Wanderlane Gold | general queue | 24 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | dedicated line | 12 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | dedicated line | 6 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | dedicated line | 2 |

The response figure tightens at every step of the programme, while the dedicated line begins at Wanderlane Platinum. Wanderlane Gold therefore reaches the general queue and still carries a written response figure of 24 hours.
